title: NVIDIA Board of Directors Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee

quotes.text: November 17, 2026
a new standing committee responsible for board-level oversight of the company’s national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management
The Committee will be chaired by director Suzanne Nora Johnson and will also include directors Stephen C. Neal and John O. Dabiri as members.
It will meet at least quarterly, including with management and in executive session.
NVIDIA’s existing National Security Team and Global Trade Compliance Team will report directly to the Committee and to Interim CEO, Colette Kress, on day-to-day operations.
